decision: Add hybrid keyword + semantic search feature

alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: Would miss semantic/conceptual matches; limited utility
Adds heavy dependencies and operational overhead; conflicts with goal of pure local solution

chosen_solution: Enhance search.py with hybrid scoring combining keyword Jaccard similarity and positional semantic ranking
why_better: Re-uses existing LanceDB + Ollama stack, introduces only modest storage overhead, provides the best of both worlds
security_measures_added: Query length limits (512 chars), weight clamping (0.0-1.0), type validation, control character filtering
next_steps: Phase 4: Security hardening complete, Phase 5: Testing, Phase 6: Documentation
